crossRefs.note: For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive, abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you.
Remember me, Yahweh, with the favor that you show to your people. Visit me with your salvation,
that I may see the prosperity of your chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of your nation, that I may glory with…
Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort;

translations.web: Please let your loving kindness be for my comfort, according to your word to your servant.
translations.bsb: May Your loving devotion comfort me, I pray, according to Your promise to Your servant.
translations.kjv: Let, I pray thee, thy merciful kindness be for my comfort, according to thy word unto thy servant.
translations.asv: Let, I pray thee, thy lovingkindness be for my comfort, According to thy word unto thy servant.
